def comp_bfs(seed, adjl, nc):
    """seed: node indices at distance 0; adjl: adjacency lists of (eid, other)."""
    dist = [-1] * nc
    pnode = [-1] * nc
    peid = [0] * nc
    q = []
    for s in seed:
        if dist[s] < 0:
            dist[s] = 0
            q.append(s)
    qi = 0
    while qi < len(q):
        u = q[qi]
        qi += 1
        d = dist[u] + 1
        for eid, t in adjl[u]:
            if dist[t] < 0:
                dist[t] = d
                pnode[t] = u
                peid[t] = eid
                q.append(t)
    return dist, pnode, peid


def parent_path(dist, peid, pnode, src):
    """list of (eid, target) steps walking src backwards to a distance-0 node"""
    chain = []
    w = src
    while dist[w] > 0:
        chain.append((peid[w], w))
        w = pnode[w]
    chain.reverse()
    return chain, w


def build_fair_loop(cprot, edges, fair, enm_state, tgt):
    """Closed walk of edge ids over cprot beginning at tgt; satisfies every
    declared fairness condition.  Returns None when impossible."""
    nfair = len(fair)
    DECL = (1 << nfair) - 1
    SDECL = 0
    WDECL = 0
    lbl_bit = {}
    for i, (a, m) in enumerate(fair):
        lbl_bit[a] = 1 << i
        if m == "strong":
            SDECL |= 1 << i
        else:
            WDECL |= 1 << i
    nodes = sorted(cprot)
    nc = len(nodes)
    idx = {}
    for i, s in enumerate(nodes):
        idx[s] = i
    emask = [0] * nc
    dmask = [0] * nc
    for i in range(nc):
        en = enm_state[nodes[i]]
        emask[i] = en & DECL
        dmask[i] = (~en) & DECL
    fwd = [[] for _ in range(nc)]
    bwd = [[] for _ in range(nc)]
    ie = []
    for eid in range(len(edges)):
        s, lab, t = edges[eid]
        if s in cprot and t in cprot:
            u = idx[s]
            v = idx[t]
            fwd[u].append((eid, v))
            bwd[v].append((eid, u))
            ie.append((u, v, eid, lbl_bit.get(lab, 0)))
    tgti = idx[tgt]
    covA = dmask[tgti]
    covEn = emask[tgti]
    walk_mask = 0
    covered = set([tgti])
    # initial closed walk: cycle through tgti
    dist, pnode, peid = comp_bfs([tgti], fwd, nc)
    best = None
    for u, v, eid, ab in ie:
        if v == tgti and dist[u] >= 0 and (best is None or dist[u] < best[0]):
            best = (dist[u], u, eid)
    if best is None:
        # no cycle through tgti: only the implicit stutter is available
        if (covEn & ~walk_mask & SDECL) | (~covA & ~walk_mask & WDECL):
            return None
        return [-1]
    _, srcu, backeid = best
    W = []
    chain0, x = parent_path(dist, peid, pnode, srcu)
    chain0.append((backeid, tgti))
    for e, t in chain0:
        W.append([e, t])
        covered.add(t)
        covA |= dmask[t]
        covEn |= emask[t]
        walk_mask |= lbl_bit.get(edges[e][1], 0)
    while True:
        viol = (covEn & ~walk_mask & SDECL) | (~covA & ~walk_mask & WDECL)
        if viol == 0:
            break
        abit = viol & -viol
        covlist = list(covered)
        df, fpar, feid = comp_bfs(covlist, fwd, nc)
        db, bpar, beid = comp_bfs(covlist, bwd, nc)
        bestc = None
        for u, v, eid, ab in ie:
            if ab == abit and df[u] >= 0 and db[v] >= 0:
                cost = df[u] + 1 + db[v]
                if bestc is None or cost < bestc[0]:
                    bestc = (cost, u, v, eid)
        if bestc is None:
            return None
        _, u, v, eida = bestc
        chain, x = parent_path(df, feid, fpar, u)
        chain.append((eida, v))
        chain2, y = parent_path(db, beid, bpar, v)
        chain.extend(chain2)
        # insert after the walk segment ending at x
        at_x = None
        for i in range(len(W) - 1, -1, -1):
            if W[i][1] == x:
                at_x = i
                break
        if at_x is None:
            return None
        W[at_x + 1:at_x + 1] = list(chain)
        for e, t in chain:
            covered.add(t)
            covA |= dmask[t]
            covEn |= emask[t]
            walk_mask |= lbl_bit.get(edges[e][1], 0)
    return [e for e, _ in W]
